g.text: How two I/Q components become one real stream

g.text: The conversion changes the representation and sample count. It preserves both components subject to filtering and fixed-point

g.text: +Iu[0], -Qu[1], -Iu[2], +Qu[3], then repeat the signs. These are interpolated values at successive output times, not four

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65778a

g.text: 65,536 pairs become 262,144 real samples for the same 0.262144 s
recording. The 1 MHz sample interpretation is not a measured hardware

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d78a8

g.text: This fixed interpolation filter supports format conversion. The adjustable
THR2 decision remains in the shared spectral processing core.
